violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the vertical open air cooler, right side: cut honeydew (58f), ham and cheese sandwich (46f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE FOOD.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): 1) coffee creamers 2) sweet frank roll, croque mon
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1) vertical open air cooler, right side was observed at 46f
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC CALLED FOR A SERVICE TECHNICIAN TO REPAIR COOLER.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: A certified food manager (CFM) was not present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CFM ARRIVED DURING THE INSPECTION. HAVE MULTIPLE STAFF MEMBERS BECOME CFMs. A CFM MUST BE PRESENT AT ALL HOURS OF OPERATION. PIC STATES THEY ARE WORKING ON GETTING MORE STAFF CERTIFIED.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Paper towels were not observed at the coffee bar hand sink
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC PLACED A NEW PAPER TOWEL ROLL AT THIS HAND SINK

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: In the self-service hot holding cabinet, a frank roll was observed at 102f. Upon discussion with PIC, food in the hot holding cabinet is not using Time as a Public Health Control.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC DISCARDED THE FOOD.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: SPICY MAYO
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE FOOD.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: Observed cold medicine being stored in the walk-in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. PIC MOVED THE PERSONAL CARE ITEMS TO THE OFFICE.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PURCHASE A FOOD PROBE THERMOMETER BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food on Display, Guards/Packaging
violations.observation: Observed egg tarts, destined for self-service, being stored in the open air cooler without any type of packaging or sneeze guard
violations.corrective_action: Food on display shall be protected from contamination by the use of packaging, counter, service line, or salad bar food guards, display cases, or other effective means. PIC DISCARDED THE EGG TARTS. FOOD ON DISPLAY FOR SELF-SERVICE NEED TO HAVE SOME KIND OF PHYSICAL BARRIER TO PROTECT THE FOOD FROM CONTAMINATION.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for sanitizing the counter top were observed being stored in a wire basket by the handsink at the coffee bar.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. STORE WET WIPING CLOTHS IN A CONTAINER OF SANITIZER.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Observed METAL MIXING BOWLS AND A FRYING PAN that have been cleaned not stored covered or inverted.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored covered or inverted to prevent contamination. PIC INVERTED THE BOWLS AND PUT THE FRYING PAN IN THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
